newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends off on Brent, weak physical marke.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends off on Brent, weak physical marke.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed lower on Thursday as they tracked Brent lower against the backdrop of a sickly physical gas oil market, traders said.
June gas oil settled $3 off at $165.75 a tonne while July IPE gas oil closed $2.75 down at $167.75 a tonne.
July Brent futures were trading 32 cents lower at $18.40 a barrel at 1705 GMT.
Most traders said gas oil was mainly off in sympathy with a drop in Brent futures which were off on a weaker physical market.
Physical Brent traders said on Thursday that North Sea Brent was under pressure from ample June supply, a closed U.S. arbitrage door and generally low refiner demand.
Some said that heavy selling of gas oil futures by a UK broker earlier on had also pressured prices.
The sickly state of the physical gas oil barge market was also seen as taking its toll on prices.
